headline: Americans Stop Moving as Mortgage Lock-In Persists: Home Depot Sees 'No Sign' of Housing Turnaround
summary: Moving plans hit a record low as mortgage lock-in keeps homeowners put, while Home Depot sees “no sign” of a housing turnaround.
